about.title: About Us
about.game_description: NYT Connections is an engaging word categorization game where players need to find connections between 16 words and sort them into 4 groups of 4.
about.how_to_play_description: Each day brings a new puzzle. Select 4 related words and submit to verify your answer. You have 4 chances to make mistakes. Win by finding all 4 groups!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.data_collection_description: We only collect essential information needed to provide our services, including game progress and basic usage data.
privacy.data_usage_description: Collected data is used solely to improve user experience and game functionality. We do not use your personal information for other purposes.
privacy.cookies_description: We use cookies to save your game progress and preferences. These are necessary for the proper functioning of the website.
